svg.title: FIG-01 当前平台分层与外部边界 FIG-01 Platform layers and product boundary
svg.desc: 外部产品工程：产品与安全政策 External product and safety policy; 任务 / 服务 / 协议 / 私有分区 调度、预算、恢复与停机协调 tasks / services / protocols / private layout scheduling, budgets, recovery, shutdown; 外部 TOML 装配 Board / backend / 实例 / 资源预算 external TOML assembly Board / backend / instances / budgets; Nexus：可复用机制与已维护 provider Nexus: reusable mechanisms and providers; 可选组件：owner / 器件 / 存储窄端口 optional owner / device / storage ports; 可选 OS：任务、等待与通知端口 任务存储与内核启动由外部提供 optional OS task / wait / notify external task storage and kernel start; Platform：生成的静态装配 typed factory / start / stop generated static Platform assembly; I/O：公共类型、只读 face、checked dispatch public types / readonly faces / checks; SoC provider：控制器 / IRQ / DMA 私有状态、时钟、timebase、内存事实 controller / IRQ / DMA implementation private state, clock, timebase, memory; Arch：CPU 原语与显式机制 mask / barrier / cache / MPU / SAU CPU primitives and explicit mechanisms; Core：status / deadline / request 小型共用合同，无硬件 registry small common rules, no device registry; Board：引脚 / 晶振 / 授权路线 / 来源 构建期事实，不是日常 I/O 转发层 pins / oscillators / routes / provenance build-time facts, no runtime forwarding; 所选 MCU 与 PCB 实板资格需独立取得 selected MCU / PCB separate physical qualification; 解析后生成（构建期） resolved generation (build time); 事实与授权（构建期） facts / authorization (build time); 取得身份、显式启停 lookup identity / explicit start-stop; 日常直接 I/O direct ordinary I/O; 显式选择 explicit opt-in; 显式选择 explicit opt-in; 按组件合同访问设备 device access under component contract; 使用共用合同 shared contracts; 等待与时间合同 wait and time contracts; ops(context, ...) 分派 ops(context, ...) dispatch; 检查与生命周期合同 checked lifecycle rules; 调用 CPU 原语 direct CPU primitive calls; 使用请求与时间合同 request and time rules; 所选寄存器 / IRQ / DMA selected register / IRQ / DMA access
